title: Hash Brown Frittata
description: A Mediterranean-inspired breakfast dish using sweet potatoes and Manchego cheese. Perfect for a sunny morning!
instructions: In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the diced sweet potatoes and hash, and cook for about 5-7 minutes, until they're lightly browned.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour the egg mixture over the sweet potatoes and hash.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for about 20-25 minutes, until the eggs are set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle Manchego cheese on top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata and serve warm.
Note: If using a non-stick skillet, reduce the amount of olive oil used for frying.
